original_test_intent: Run the approved NVIDIA system thermal qualification workload across the defined GPU/baseboard scope and verify component temperatures, throttling, errors and firmware identity against the platform limits.
original_method: Pin signed NVQual build/config and device roster; establish ambient/cooling/load baseline; approve duration, power/thermal limits and abort/recovery; isolate services; execute the exact vendor thermal module with telemetry; retain per-component results/errors; stop safely and confirm cooldown, logs and health.
manual_activity: Thermal/vendor owner supplies the licensed artifact and qualification envelope and approves the sustained-load window; agent may run only that exact governed module.
required_inputs: Signed NVQual version/hash/license and exact module/config
Ambient/cooling setup, duration and workload parameters
Per-sensor limits, throttle/error rules and FW manifest
safety_requirements: No embedded credentials or log clearing
Dedicated SUT and continuous thermal/power monitoring
Hard abort on limit, XID, fan or management loss
agent_execution_scope: Run one bounded vendor thermal qualification
engineer_actions: Resolve criteria and approve thermal contract

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `nvqual thermal` is unsupported by the source and omits all qualification parameters.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the pinned vendor-documented thermal module/config after target, duration, threshold and recovery approval.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The system thermal-qualification purpose is retained; absent parameters are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a component/sensor threshold matrix tied to the immutable NVQual run manifest and time-aligned telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Turns a recommendation into an auditable qualification procedure.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Readability and firmware strings alone do not validate thermal behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Proprietary module behavior and load envelope cannot be inferred without vendor package documentation.

project_override_considerations: The project must define whether this covers whole-system or GPU-only thermal qualification and the exact environment class.
expected_evidence: Threshold calculations, cooldown/final health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure describes active thermal qualification while Criteria only check text readability and firmware version, providing no thermal acceptance.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row302 Wistron-NV GPU-00295-V003: approve the exact NVQual thermal module/config, component scope, ambient/load/duration and thermal/power/throttle/error limits, and replace or map the unrelated readability/FW Criteria without changing Master.

review_improvement: Prevents a generic firmware/readability screen from being counted as system thermal qualification.
independent_technical_reasoning: A thermal qualification result depends on the applied load, environment, duration and component limits; none can be recovered from the word recommended. A guessed binary name would create unverifiable coverage and could overheat hardware, so immutable vendor semantics and hard aborts are prerequisites.
